onset: First day at least 2 of own b20/b60/dd120 at or below preceding 750 valid observations 5th percentile (min250), and dd120<=-10%. No synthetic split from return jumps.
entry: Next market session open only; unavailable opening remains cash. Same initial cash per episode; no redeployment.
exit: -20% stop; TW+50% / US+30% target; common 60th stock-bar close marked including fees; not formal 120/90-bar strategy returns.
limits: Previously examined periods; not fresh holdout
Current universe/revised adjusted bars, no full delisted universe or queue/tax reconstruction
Same-stock episode windows do not overlap; stocks can cluster together
Missed confirmations remain zero-return cash; filled-only mean shown separately
Last incomplete episodes retained; full60 comparison separately reported
20-bar anchor failure is descriptive after the signal, not a prediction
